g.text: In distributed systems, many computers (called nodes) work together over a network.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Consensus means all these nodes must agree on a single value or decision — even when

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: things go wrong, like network delays or crashed machines.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Imagine you and 4 friends are deciding where to eat dinner

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: — over text. Everyone needs to agree on ONE place.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Sounds easy, right? Now imagine some friends have no signal,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: some reply late, and one is secretly trolling.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: That's the consensus problem in distributed systems!

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: It means that a perfect consensus algorithm cannot exist if the system has:

g.text: The Byzantine Generals Problem describes a situation where distributed nodes must agree

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: on a decision, but some nodes may behave maliciously or send incorrect information.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Several generals are surrounding a city:

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: -> If all generals attack together → they win.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: -> If some attack and some retreat → they lose.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: -> Generals communicate using messengers But some generals may be traitors.
